data.long_meaning: The name Dennis is derived from the ancient Greek name Dionysios, which means 'follower of Dionysus'. In Greek mythology, Dionysus was the god of the vine, the grape harvest, winemaking, wine, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, and theatre. Dennis was adopted as a personal name in the English-speaking world. The name Dennis carries the meaning “Follower of Dionysus” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dennis usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of dionysus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
